items.text: Task 1 — Doorway: /epr/{id}/raw forces ServeShell (never 302). Parse the path tail; raw suffix short-circuits to ServeShell before the claimed-mount lookup. TDD on classify_epr_universal.
items.note: implemented + locally gate-green; a2o E2E verifies on next CI

items.text: Task 2 — Doorway: add content_format to HeadFacts (tolerant, additive). Surface existing ContentNode.contentFormat at /epr resolution; rail for Slice 1, used by the raw view. Deserialization test.
items.note: DEFERRED to Slice 1 (contentFormat on HeadFacts is a format-driven-dispatch rail, unused by the raw view)

items.text: Task 3 — Storage: confirm/raise the raw-node read (resource + relatedNodeIds + provenance). FIRST check existing endpoints suffice; only add thinnest read (prefer extending /db/content/{id}) if provenance unreachable. Full neighborhood closure is Slice 1.
items.note: no-op: /db/content/{id} already returns id/contentType/contentFormat/blobHash/dhtAnchorHash/createdBy/metadata — no storage change

items.text: Task 4 — App (shell): /epr/:id/raw raw-node viewer component (data-testid=epr-raw-node). Renders EPR as atom: CID, contentType, contentFormat, blob, relatedNodeIds as /epr links, provenance. No pillar chrome. Vitest spec.
items.note: implemented + locally gate-green; a2o E2E verifies on next CI

items.text: Task 5 — App (lamad): repoint View-as-Content from /epr/{id} (round-trips) to /epr/{id}/raw. Cross-bundle plain href/EprNavService, never routerLink. path-overview.component.html.
items.note: implemented + locally gate-green; a2o E2E verifies on next CI

items.text: Task 6 — a2o @regression: /epr/{path-id}/raw renders the raw-node view (not a 302 to mount); View-as-Content lands on /raw. Guards the captured contradiction. Opus authors narrative.
